subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should shared reply-session code own canonical conflict recovery while Discord retains this bounded retry only as defense in depth?
rationale: Both this PR and the open shared recovery PR handle the same initialization conflict at different layers; code review alone cannot determine whether maintainers want both recovery stages or one canonical owner.

options.title: Shared Owner Plus Discord Fallback
options.body: Use shared session recovery as the permanent owner and land the narrow Discord retry after rebasing and confirming it remains non-duplicative defense in depth.

options.title: Shared Recovery Only
options.body: Pause this PR and rely on the shared-session fix if maintainers conclude it fully prevents Discord message loss without channel-specific retry policy.

options.title: Channel Recovery Only
options.body: Land this Discord path and decline shared recovery for this failure class, accepting channel-specific ownership and parity maintenance.

recommendation.title: Shared Owner Plus Discord Fallback
recommendation.body: Use shared session recovery as the permanent owner and land the narrow Discord retry after rebasing and confirming it remains non-duplicative defense in depth.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the Discord handler structure and adjacent session-lifecycle policy.
